name: Tab Out
description: Keep tabs on your tabs. New tab page that groups your open tabs by domain, lets you close them with style, with tab sessions + drag-reorder + click search. Sessions show tab titles with inline rename (not URLs); sessions are drag-to-reorderable and so are the tabs inside each expanded session. Open-status indicator updates live when you close tabs elsewhere. No keyboard shortcuts, no server, no account, 100% local.
